The four JSON files here are answers recorded from a Caséta Smart Bridge, copied
unchanged from [pylutron-caseta](https://github.com/gurumitts/pylutron-caseta)'s
`tests/responses`, which is under the Apache License 2.0; [LICENSE](LICENSE) here is that
license, for these four files and nothing else in this repository. They are test data:
the shapes this package's types are checked against.
